questions.prompt: Six distinct books are arranged on a shelf. Three of the books are mathematics books and three are history books.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements in which the 3 mathematics books are placed together.

questions.prompt: Six people stand in a straight line: Ben, Chloe, and 4 other friends.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements in which Ben and Chloe stand next to each other.

questions.prompt: Four boys and three girls stand in a row.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements in which all the boys stand together and all the girls stand together.

questions.prompt: The word REQUIREMENT has 11 letters, including 3 Es and 2 Rs.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements of all 11 letters of the word REQUIREMENT in which the two letters R are together and the three letters E are together.

questions.prompt: Three distinct red counters, two distinct blue counters, and three distinct green counters are placed in a row.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements in which all the red counters are together and all the blue counters are together.

questions.prompt: Five people stand in a straight line, including Jack and Jill.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements in which Jack and Jill stand next to each other, but neither of them stands at either end of the line.

questions.prompt: Seven children, consisting of 3 brothers and 4 sisters, stand in a line.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements in which all 3 brothers stand together.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements in which all 3 brothers stand together and all 4 sisters stand together.

questions.prompt: The word CHAPTER has 7 distinct letters.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements of all 7 letters of the word CHAPTER in which the two vowels (A and E) are together.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements of all 7 letters of the word CHAPTER in which all 5 consonants are together and the two vowels are together.

questions.prompt: The word TRIANGLES has 9 distinct letters, consisting of 3 vowels (I, A, E) and 6 consonants (T, R, N, G, L, S).

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements of all 9 letters of the word TRIANGLES in which all 3 vowels are together.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements of all 9 letters of the word TRIANGLES in which all 3 vowels are together and the word begins and ends with a consonant.

questions.prompt: Eight students, consisting of 3 from School A, 3 from School B, and 2 from School C, stand in a line.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements in which all 3 students from School A stand together and all 3 students from School B stand together.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements in which the 3 students from School A stand together, the 3 students from School B stand together, and the 2 students from School C stand together.

questions.prompt: The word EXCELLENT has 9 letters, including 3 Es and 2 Ls.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements of all 9 letters of the word EXCELLENT in which all three letters E are together.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of different arrangements of all 9 letters of the word EXCELLENT in which all three letters E are together and the two letters L are together.

questions.prompt: Seating arrangements in a theatre are being organised.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: A theatre has a front row of 6 seats. Two friends, Paul and Quinn, sit together in this row. Find the number of different seatings for Paul and Quinn.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: In the same theatre, there are 4 other rows that each have 6 seats. Paul and Quinn sit together in the front row, and three other friends, Ruth, Sam, and Tina, sit together in one of the other 4 rows. Find the total number of different ways that these 5 people can be seated.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Six friends sit in a single row of 6 seats. Two specified friends, Dan and Eva, refuse to sit next to each other. Find the number of different arrangements of the 6 friends in which Dan and Eva are not seated together.

questions.prompt: Arrangements of groups of people standing in a line are being considered.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Ten people stand in a line. Liam and Mia must stand next to each other, but neither of them may stand at either end of the line. Find the number of different arrangements.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Ten people stand in a line. Find the number of different arrangements in which Liam and Mia stand next to each other, and a specified third person, Noah, stands at one of the ends of the line.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: A group of 9 people consists of 3 couples and 3 single individuals. Each couple must sit together as a pair. Find the number of different arrangements of all 9 people in a line.
